provenance.instrument: Uwchlan Township Code Chapter 265 Zoning (Uwchlan Township Zoning Ordinance of 1994, Ord. No. 94-11, 7-11-1994, as amended), as published on eCode360
provenance.status_detail: eCode360 code date 2025-10-13 (breadcrumb). New Laws on 2026-11-14 for Chapter 265: Ord. No. 2021-05 (Zoning Amendment, 2021-09-13), Ord. No. 2026-06 (Zoning Map Amendment, 2026-05-11) and Ord. No. 2026-08 (Zoning Amendment, 2026-08-10), PDF only, not read.
provenance.code_current_through_note: eCode360 breadcrumb 'Code 2025-10-13'. Zoning amendments Ord. No. 2021-05 and 2026-08 and map amendment Ord. No. 2026-06 are listed as New Laws, not yet in the code text.
provenance.code_caution: Zoning amendment Ord. No. 2021-05 (adopted 2021-09-13) is listed as a New Law for Chapter 265 and was not read (PDF only). It may change the rules below. Ord. No. 2026-08 (Zoning Amendment, 2026-08-10) and Ord. No. 2026-06 (Zoning Map Amendment, 2026-05-11) are also listed and were not read.
checks: The code has no general accessory dwelling unit rule. The residential districts list single-family detached dwellings and accessory uses 'clearly incidental to the principal use' (501.2, 501.3, 502.2, 502.3, 503.2, 503.3, 504.2, 504.3)

The code's 'Guesthouse, as an accessory dwelling' is short-term lodging, not a home for a household. A guest house is 'An accessory single-family dwelling on a lot available for short-term rental' (301.4). No guest, individual or family may stay longer than 90 consecutive days in any 180 days (612.7f(1))

The guesthouse is a conditional use in every district only if more than one historic resource exists on the property, inside a building designated as a historic resource. Two off-street parking spaces beyond those of the house. No walk-in trade (612.7a, 612.7f)

A historic resource may be enlarged only as minimally needed, as a guideline by no more than 50% of its footprint. Work should follow the Secretary of the Interior's Standards for Rehabilitation (612.7b, 612.5a)

Conversion of a historic resource into dwellings is a conditional use in every district: 3 parking spaces per unit (not in the front yard), lot area per unit at least the district lot area, no enlargement, units of at least 500 contiguous sq ft (612.7b(1), 612.7e)
R-2 allows two-family detached and semidetached dwellings on a lot of at least 20 acres. Two-family detached 24,000 sq ft and 120 ft wide per building (504.2c, d, 504.6)

Detached accessory buildings (other than garages up to 120 sq ft) may stand in the required rear yard, at least 10 ft from the rear line and no closer to the side line than the district allows (603.1)
The Historic Resources Map and Inventory and the Inventory List are attachments (PDF) and were not read. Ask the Zoning Officer whether a property is listed
provenance.notes: Zoning office: Uwchlan Township (Chester County) Zoning Officer. Read on eCode360 (UW2708) in a browser, one page at a time, on 2026-11-14. Fix round 2026-11-14: the guest house definition (301.4, Ord. No. 2013-06) and 612.7 were read again. The guesthouse is short-term rental lodging, so it is no longer the historic ADU path. It is listed as an alternative. New Laws list checked again (Ord. No. 2021-05, 2026-06, 2026-08 for zoning). Code search (all content, New Laws included) for 'accessory dwelling', 'accessory apartment', 'in-law', ECHO, granny, 'family dwelling', relative, caretaker, 'housekeeping unit', 'guest house', 'accessory unit', 'living quarters', conversion and duplex found the guest house definition (301.4), the family and dwelling unit definitions and living quarters for a proprietor, manager, caretaker or watchman in PC (505). The historic preservation section (612) holds the guesthouse and conversion paths. Use lists read: R-A, R-R, R-1, R-2. PC, PC-2, PIC, PCID and PI use lists not read except the 612.7a table. Parking (607) not read.

term.note: The code has no term for an accessory dwelling for a household. Its only 'accessory dwelling' is the guesthouse in a historic resource (612.7f), and a guest house is 'An accessory single-family dwelling on a lot available for short-term rental' (301.4). Stays are limited to 90 consecutive days in any 180 days. Searched for accessory dwelling, accessory apartment, in-law, ECHO, granny, family dwelling, relative, caretaker, housekeeping unit, guest house, accessory unit, living quarters, conversion and duplex.

status.note: No district lists an accessory dwelling unit for a household. The guesthouse in a historic resource is short-term lodging, listed under the alternatives.

path.note: A second dwelling unit on a single-family lot is not a listed use. It needs a use variance from the Zoning Hearing Board (MPC 910.2). On a property with historic resources, see the alternatives.

fallback_path.note: Relief from a district rule is a variance from the Zoning Hearing Board.

value.name: Residential conversion of a historic resource
value.conditions: Site and architectural plans with the conditional use application. At least 3 parking spaces per dwelling unit, between the building and the required yards, none in the front yard. Lot area per dwelling unit at least the district lot area (20,000 sq ft with public sewer and water in nonresidential districts). District area and bulk rules met. No outside change except for safety. No enlargement. Each unit at least 500 contiguous sq ft.

requires.condition: The building is a historic resource on the Historic Resources Map and Inventory

value.name: Guesthouse, as an accessory dwelling, in a second historic building (short-term rental only)
value.conditions: Only if more than one historic resource exists on the property, and inside a building designated as a historic resource. Short-term lodging: 'No guest, individual or family may stay longer than 90 consecutive days during any consecutive period of 180 days.' Amenities for guests only, no walk-in trade. Two off-street parking spaces beyond those of the house. Enlargement only as minimally needed (guideline at most 50% of the footprint), Secretary of the Interior's Standards, landscaping plan, 602.1 and 603 in residential districts.
